insight: Science opens the most doors — engineering medicine research even finance and law later.
tradeoff: The workload in 11th-12th is genuinely heavy. Physics Chemistry Maths together is a lot.
action: Sit in on a class or watch a few lectures in the subjects you'd actually study — not the career outcomes the actual content.
tension: The tension: PCM (engineering path) vs. PCB (medical path). You can't easily switch after 11th so this decision matters.

insight: Commerce is more flexible than people think — it leads to CA MBA banking marketing and even tech roles.
tradeoff: It's often chosen as a safe option which means some students end up in it without real interest.
action: Talk to a CA or MBA student about what their day actually looks like — not the salary the work.
tension: The tension: CA route (structured long high reward) vs. MBA route (faster broader more expensive). Very different commitments.

insight: Arts gives you the most freedom to explore — history psychology political science literature all in one stream.
tradeoff: The career paths are less linear which requires more self-direction than most 16-year-olds are ready for.
action: Pick one subject from the arts stream and go deep on it for a month — see if the depth excites you or bores you.
tension: The tension: humanities for its own sake (fulfilling harder to monetise) vs. humanities as a path to law civil services or media (more structured).

insight: Vocational streams are underrated — you come out with a real marketable skill and can start earning faster than most.
tradeoff: The social perception is still catching up. Some doors (like certain college programs) may require additional qualifications later.
action: Research which specific trade has the best job market in your city right now — the difference between trades can be significant.
tension: The tension: starting work early (faster income less flexibility) vs. upgrading to a diploma or degree later (slower more options).

insight: If you're serious about sports this is the right path — it gives you structured training alongside academics.
tradeoff: The window for professional sports is narrow. Having a backup plan isn't giving up — it's being smart.
action: Get a realistic assessment from your coach about your competitive level — not encouragement an honest evaluation.
tension: The tension: pursuing sports as a career (high risk high reward) vs. sports science or coaching (more stable still in the field).

insight: Creative fields are growing — design animation film and digital art are all in demand.
tradeoff: Building a portfolio takes years and the early income can be unpredictable.
action: Start building a portfolio now before you even finish 10th — the earlier you start the better your options at 12th.
tension: The tension: fine arts as a craft (painting sculpture performance) vs. applied arts (design animation UX). Very different career markets.

insight: Agriculture is being transformed by technology — agritech food science and sustainable farming are real career paths.
tradeoff: Traditional agriculture is hard work with uncertain income. The opportunity is in the tech and business side of it.
action: Visit one agritech startup or agricultural research institute — seeing what modern agriculture looks like changes the perception completely.
tension: The tension: traditional farming (land-dependent uncertain) vs. agritech and food science (urban-friendly growing fast).
